issues.quote: Operating income climbed to $36.9 billion in fiscal 2023 from $15.5 billion in fiscal 2022
issues.problem: Amazon's fiscal 2022 operating income was about $12.2 billion ($12,248M), not $15.5 billion.

data.summary: Most figures are correct (revenue, gross profit, margins, net income, EPS), but fiscal 2022 operating income is misstated: it was $12.2B, not $15.5B.
